statement: ∀ (s r a b : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Path), s ≤ r → KdVPlan.EssBound r a b f → KdVPlan.EssBound s a b f ∧ KdVPlan.EssH s a b f ≤ KdVPlan.EssH r a b f
proof:
intro s r a b f hsr hf
have hb : ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Icc a b), KdVPlan.HB s (f t) (KdVPlan.EssH r a b f) := by
 filter_upwards [hf.2.1, @yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 r a b f hf] with t ht hb
 have hh := h_T013.2.2.2.1 s r (f t) hsr ht
 exact ⟨hh.1, hh.2.trans hb⟩
have hout := @yui_aux_0033 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 s a b f (KdVPlan.EssH r a b f) hf.1 hb
simpa only [max_eq_left (show 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH r a b f from ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)] using hout
